_readme: Switch any topo-merge feature or layer on/off. Edit and rebuild (npm run build) or restart npm run dev. Add ?topo=off to any URL to disable the whole merge in the browser for a quick before/after.
_excludeUpstreamNote: DEFAULT: Google Open Buildings is excluded. Overture republishes it but its records carry no licence field here, and the project rule is never to use Google data without sign-off. Remove it from this list and re-run npm run topo-merge to include those outlines. Microsoft ML Buildings records declare ODbL-1.0.
_features: Add "<feature id>": false to hide one feature. Ids: topo:<overture id> (added buildings, hostels, roads), dup:<osm way id> (suppressed duplicate), <osm way id> (a replacement), topo-green-N. Add "layers.terrain" is not used here: Terrain has its own in-app toggle.
